title: Mamdani Draws Anger With Oct. 7 Statement Denouncing Israel’s Gaza Attacks
summary: After calling the anniversary of the attacks on Israel “profoundly painful,” Mayor Zohran Mamdani denounced Israel’s military action in Gaza, prompting criticism from some Jewish leaders.
